other_conditions: The worker must have at least the last 2 years of registration with the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Worker’s Welfare Board.
The building must be documented after 29/06/2020 (date of resolution of the scheme).
The application must be made within one year from the date mentioned in the house purchase document.
The loan taken for the house must not exceed ₹15 lakhs and must have a tenure of 10 years or more.
The worker must not own any house or property jointly with anyone, including his spouse; an affidavit in the prescribed format must be submitted as a guarantee.
The worker must submit the bank loan interest certificate or bank loan statement after the completion of the financial year to avail assistance.

After the first assistance, the worker must submit a written proposal each year at the district office, along with a copy of the in‑principle approval letter and the annual statement of interest, to receive the remaining four years of assistance.
benefits_summary: A total assistance of ₹1,50,000 is provided to eligible workers over five years, disbursed as ₹30,000 per year.
documents_required: Bank loan interest certificate or bank loan statement
